hero.title: Asset Tracking and Analysis
hero.subtitle2: Understand asset location, condition, performance, and life cycle

intro.title: Enhance asset performance
intro.paragraph: Asset managers must minimize risks and maximize performance while managing cost and resources for both fixed and moving assets. Innovative managers use smart maps and dashboards to achieve a holistic view of their assets. Location intelligence enhances day-to-day operations such as inspections, maintenance, and investment planning.

enhance.title: Enhance asset performance
enhance.body: Use maps and dashboards to unify data about asset location, condition, and performance so your teams can act faster and with confidence. Connect information from inspections and work orders to reduce downtime and extend asset life.

performance.title: See the performance others can’t
performance.intro: When managers use smart maps and visualizations to perform asset tracking and analysis, they help their organizations reduce errors, save time, and make informed, data-driven decisions.
bullets: Increase inventory accuracy by using modern data-collection apps.
Track asset condition and performance in real time throughout the life cycle.
Share status updates quickly and seamlessly with the field and office.
Forecast maintenance costs and needs to improve reliability.
Integrate fully into existing asset management systems and inventory tracking.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Enhance asset tracking and analysis for improved asset management with location intelligence technology from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Spatial Analysis and Data Science
items.body: Use location as the connective thread to uncover hidden patterns and trends for enhanced asset tracking and analysis. Gain a competitive edge by integrating location into machine learning models and artificial intelligence.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Know asset location and condition in real time and predict failures before they can happen. Use location intelligence based on the most up-to-date information to make informed decisions about asset tracking and analysis.

items.title: Field Operations
items.body: Improve coordination and operational efficiency in workforce activities. Reduce or even replace paper reliance, modernize workflows for reliable and accessible data, and access the power of location anywhere.

items.excerpt: The city now uses digital rather than paper processes for inspecting, maintaining, and managing its assets.

items.title: A New Data Model Keeps a Solar Field Beaming
items.excerpt: To manage assets in a new solar facility efficiently, The City of Loveland tracks not only assets but also maintenance schedules and costs.

items.title: GIS and BIM Support University’s Assets
items.excerpt: Ohio State University implemented a new building information system to improve management of hundreds of facilities and assets on its campuses.
